run_eigh: run eigenvalue decomposition on a matrix using cupy with EighResult namedtuple output
run_svd: run singular value decomposition on a matrix using cupy with SVDResult namedtuple output
run_cholesky: run cholesky decomposition on a positive-definite matrix using cupy with optional upper flag
run_qr: run qr factorization on a matrix using cupy with QRResult namedtuple output
run_slogdet: run sign and log-determinant computation on a square matrix using cupy with SlogdetResult namedtuple output
